hooks.command: sh -c 'ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); if [ -x "$ROOT/scripts/agy-lint-runner.sh" ]; then "$ROOT/scripts/agy-lint-runner.sh"; fi'

sh -c '
INPUT=$(cat 2>/dev/null || true)
CMD="${TOOL_INPUT:-}"
[ -z "$CMD" ] && CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | grep -o "\"CommandLine\":\"[^\"]*\"" || true)
echo "$CMD" | grep -q "agy-test-runner.sh" || { printf "{}"; exit 0; }
ERR="${TOOL_ERROR:-}"
[ -z "$ERR" ] && ERR=$(echo "$INPUT" | grep -o "\"error\":\"[^\"]*\"" | grep -v "\"error\":\"\"" || true)
[ -n "$ERR" ] && { printf "{}"; exit 0; }
if [ -n "${TOOL_OUTPUT:-}" ]; then
  echo "$TOOL_OUTPUT" | grep -q -E "\"exit_code\":[1-9]|exit status [1-9]" && { printf "{}"; exit 0; }
fi
ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)
cd "$ROOT"
git add -A
if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
  git commit -m "chore: auto-commit after green test gate" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
printf "{}"
exit 0
'
